# xterm.js

Browser distribution from `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0 (MIT), served locally with rho-webui.
Upstream: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/5.5.0

To update, extract `package/lib/xterm.js`, `package/css/xterm.css` and
`package/LICENSE` from the published npm package into this directory, then run the
terminal browser journey. No build or package manager is needed at installation.
